derivation: from H5971 (עַם) and H1935 (הוֹד); people of splendor;
def: Ammihud, the name of three Israelites

occurrences.text: Of the children of Joseph: of Ephraim; Elishama the son of Ammihud: of Manasseh; Gamaliel the son of Pedahzur.
On the seventh day Elishama the son of Ammihud, prince of the children of Ephraim, offered:
But Absalom fled, and went to Talmai, the son of Ammihud, king of Geshur. And David mourned for his son every day.
Laadan his son, Ammihud his son, Elishama his son,
Uthai the son of Ammihud, the son of Omri, the son of Imri, the son of Bani, of the children of Pharez the son of Judah.
